sayLines.line: Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
A person, maybe 30s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
Water over stone, loud enough to cover your noise. You could drink here without announcing it.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
Movement — a box turtle, ancient and unhurried.
👁 Slow. Walk up and pick it up. That's the whole hunt.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
Journal updated: a tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps grows here too — better than tall reeds with brown sausage-shaped heads.
The System notes the synergy — foraged a plant new to this ground: +1 field XP.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Green Thumb, Literally. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown shoots, 4× unknown shoots, 5× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
The water is cold enough to hurt your teeth. Downstream the creek bends out of sight, and you want to follow it. That's the problem with creeks.
Movement — a raccoon washing nothing in the creek.
👁 Curious, not scared. It'll come look at you. Let it.
You see smoke on the horizon. Emberhold — 12 people, 1 day in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 3 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Unfamiliar unknown roots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Slow water. The cattails stand thick.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown roots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You keep a day's food (1400 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
3 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 2 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A woman, maybe 60s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 40s, with thick glasses heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 40s, with a shaved head heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a long braid heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 20s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s says. (Trust too low.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with thick glasses returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a shaved head returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 20s returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A woman, maybe 20s eats quiet by the fire, scraping the bowl clean with their thumb.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.
A woman, maybe 20s picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
A woman, maybe 20s picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
A woman, maybe 20s picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a long braid returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A person, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin eats with A person, maybe 40s, with a shaved head — bowls side by side, talk low.
📨 Word came: Ines Duarte wants to join Haven. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to try." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: Ines Duarte applied remotely.
"Hey." A person, maybe 30s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 30s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.

A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands spends the afternoon with the giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
